text: Teach your new little one step by step (Vygotsky: ZPD): you begin → he completes → he does it alone → you encourage him. Do not do it for him, nor leave him to drown. Gradual progression builds itqan (mastery) and confidence.

review_defects.why: The Arabic likely means 'your child who is new to this' not 'your new little one' which implies a new baby. The translation could mislead.

The English adds a transliteration 'itqan' that is not present in the source. The source simply says 'mastery'. This introduces an Arabic term unnecessarily and may be inconsistent with the rest of the document.
